story: Liu Xiu was a distant member of the Han royal house who farmed in Nanyang. When revolts broke out against Wang Mang, he and his brother Liu Yan raised troops. His victory at Kunyang in 23 made his name, but the new Gengshi emperor soon had his brother killed, and Liu Xiu had to hide his grief and wait.

Sent north to Hebei, he built his own army and in 25 declared himself emperor. He made Luoyang his capital because Chang'an had been ruined in the fighting. Over the next twelve years he defeated rival claimants, including the Red Eyebrows and Gongsun Shu in Sichuan. He then cut the army, freed many slaves, lowered taxes and gave real power to a small inner secretariat.
story_zh: 刘秀是汉朝宗室的远支，原本在南阳务农。王莽末年天下大乱，他与哥哥刘縯起兵。23年的昆阳之战让他声名大振，但更始帝随即杀了刘縯，刘秀只能强忍悲痛，等待时机。
后来他奉命北上河北，借机建立了自己的队伍，25年称帝。由于长安在战火中残破，他把都城定在洛阳。此后十余年，他先后平定赤眉军和割据蜀地的公孙述等对手。统一后，他裁减军队，多次下诏释放奴婢，减轻赋税，并把实权集中到尚书台。
guangwu.why: He restored the Han for almost two more centuries and set its center of gravity in the east, around Luoyang.
guangwu.why_zh: 他让汉朝又延续了近两百年，也把王朝的重心移到了以洛阳为中心的东方。

story: According to a well-known legend, Emperor Ming dreamed of a golden figure flying in front of his palace. His advisers said it was the Buddha of the west, so he sent envoys to find out more. They came back with two Indian monks, Kasyapa Matanga and Dharmaratna, who brought scriptures and images on a white horse.

The emperor housed them at a government guesthouse outside Luoyang, which became the White Horse Temple. The monks are said to have translated the Sutra of Forty-two Chapters there. Historians treat the dream story with caution, since Buddhism was probably reaching China earlier through traders on the Silk Road. Still, the temple is honored as the first Buddhist temple in China, and its buildings, though rebuilt many times, still stand east of Luoyang.
story_zh: 相传汉明帝梦见一位金人在殿前飞行，大臣说这是西方的佛，明帝便派使者西行求法。使者带回了两位天竺僧人摄摩腾和竺法兰，他们用白马驮着佛经和佛像来到洛阳。
明帝把二僧安置在洛阳城外的官署，后来改建为白马寺。据说《四十二章经》就是在这里译出的。史学家对“夜梦金人”的故事持保留态度，因为佛教很可能更早就随丝路商人传入中国。但白马寺仍被尊为中国第一座佛寺，历经多次重建，至今仍在洛阳城东。
white-horse.why: It became the symbol of Buddhism's arrival in China, a religion that would reshape Chinese art, thought and daily life.
white-horse.why_zh: 它成为佛教传入中国的象征，而佛教后来深刻改变了中国的艺术、思想和日常生活。

story: Ban Chao came from a family of historians; his brother Ban Gu wrote the Book of Han. He threw down his writing brush to become a soldier. In 73 he was sent to Shanshan with just 36 men. When a Xiongnu embassy arrived there, he attacked its camp at night and killed the envoys, which persuaded the king to side with Han.

Over the next thirty years he used diplomacy, local troops and well-timed force to win over the oasis states of the Tarim Basin, from Khotan to Kashgar and Kucha. In 91 he was made Protector-General of the Western Regions. He returned to Luoyang in 102, old and ill, and died soon after. Han control in the region weakened after he left.
story_zh: 班超出身史学世家，哥哥班固是《汉书》的作者。他投笔从戎，73年只带三十六人出使鄯善。正逢匈奴使团也在当地，班超趁夜火攻匈奴营地，斩杀来使，迫使鄯善王归附汉朝。
此后三十年，他靠外交手腕、当地兵力和适时出击，使于阗、疏勒、龟兹等塔里木盆地诸国先后归顺。91年他被任命为西域都护。102年，年老多病的班超回到洛阳，不久去世。他离开后，汉朝在西域的控制逐渐松弛。
ban-chao.why: He kept the Silk Road open to Han trade and diplomacy, and became a model of the bold frontier officer.
ban-chao.why_zh: 他保住了汉朝通往西方的丝绸之路，也成了胆识过人的边疆将领的典范。

quote.en: If you do not enter the tiger's den, you cannot catch its cub.
quote.from: Book of the Later Han 后汉书·班超传

story: Writing in early China was done on bamboo strips, which were heavy, or on silk, which was expensive. Rough paper made from hemp already existed, but it was not good for writing. Cai Lun, a eunuch who ran the palace workshops in Luoyang, looked for a better method.

He pounded tree bark, hemp ends, old rags and fishing nets into a pulp, spread it thin on a screen and let it dry. In 105 he presented the result to Emperor He, who praised it. Paper made this way was cheap, light and easy to write on. Over the next centuries it replaced bamboo and silk in China, and later spread to Korea, Japan, the Islamic world and Europe.
story_zh: 早期中国人写字用竹简或丝帛，竹简笨重，丝帛昂贵。当时虽已有麻制的粗纸，却不便书写。掌管宫廷作坊的宦官蔡伦开始寻找更好的办法。
他把树皮、麻头、破布和旧渔网捣成纸浆，在帘上摊薄晾干。105年，他把这种纸献给汉和帝，受到称赞，人称“蔡侯纸”。这种纸便宜、轻便、易于书写，在此后几百年里逐渐取代竹简和缣帛，又传到朝鲜、日本、阿拉伯世界和欧洲。
cai-lun.why: Cheap paper made books and records far easier to produce and is counted among China's Four Great Inventions.
cai-lun.why_zh: 价廉的纸让书籍和文书的制作容易得多，造纸术被列为中国四大发明之一。

people.name: Cai Lun
people.role: Eunuch in charge of palace workshops

story: Zhang Heng was a court astronomer, poet and inventor in Luoyang. He built a water-driven armillary sphere to model the sky and wrote that the earth sat inside the heavens like the yolk inside an egg.

In 132 he presented a seismoscope: a bronze vessel with eight dragons around it, each holding a ball above an open-mouthed toad. When the ground shook, a ball was said to drop, showing the direction of the quake. The Book of the Later Han records that it once detected an earthquake in Longxi, far to the west, that no one in Luoyang had felt. The device itself has not survived, and modern reconstructions are guesses based on a short description.
story_zh: 张衡是东汉的太史令，也是诗人和发明家。他造出水力推动的浑天仪来演示天象，并提出天地如同鸡蛋，地在天中，好比蛋黄在蛋中。
132年，他制成候风地动仪：铜铸的酒樽形仪器，四周有八条龙，口含铜珠，下方各有一只张口的蟾蜍。据说地震时铜珠会落下，指示震源的方向。《后汉书》记载，它曾测到远在西边陇西的一次地震，而洛阳城里无人察觉。原物没有留传下来，今天的复原都是依据简短记载的推测。
zhang-heng.why: It is remembered as the world's first instrument for detecting earthquakes and a high point of Han science.
zhang-heng.why_zh: 它被视为世界上最早的地震仪，代表了汉代科学的高峰。

story: By the 180s the Han court was run by eunuchs, officials were selling posts, and peasants were losing their land. Zhang Jue, a faith healer in Julu, founded the Way of Great Peace and gathered hundreds of thousands of followers across eight provinces, organized into thirty-six districts.

The rising was planned for 184, a new cycle in the calendar. A betrayal forced it to start early, and rebels in yellow headscarves attacked towns across the east. The court lifted its ban on the scholar partisans and sent generals such as Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun. Zhang Jue died of illness and his brothers were killed within the year, but smaller bands fought on for two decades.
story_zh: 到了180年前后，东汉朝政被宦官把持，卖官鬻爵成风，农民大量失去土地。巨鹿人张角以符水治病传教，创立太平道，信徒遍及八州，达数十万人，分为三十六方。
起事原定在甲子年，即184年。因有人告密，只好提前发动。头裹黄巾的起义者攻打东部各地州县。朝廷解除党锢，派皇甫嵩、朱儁等将领镇压。张角当年病死，他的两个弟弟也先后战死，但各地余部又坚持了二十年。
yellow-turbans.why: Crushing it gave regional commanders their own armies, and they soon tore the Han apart.
yellow-turbans.why_zh: 镇压起义让地方将领拥兵自重，他们很快就把汉朝撕成碎片。

people.name: Zhang Jue
people.role: Leader of the Way of Great Peace

quote.zh: 苍天已死，黄天当立，岁在甲子，天下大吉
quote.en: The blue sky is dead; the yellow sky shall rise. In the jiazi year, all under heaven will prosper.
quote.from: Book of the Later Han 后汉书·皇甫嵩传

story: After the Han collapsed into warlord rule, Yuan Shao held four provinces north of the Yellow River and had the largest army in China. Cao Cao controlled the lands south of the river and held Emperor Xian. In 200 Yuan marched south and the two armies faced each other at Guandu for months.

Cao's troops were outnumbered and running short of food. Then Xu You, an adviser who had quarreled with Yuan Shao, defected and told Cao where Yuan's grain was stored at Wuchao. Cao led a night raid and burned it. Yuan's army panicked, his generals surrendered, and he fled north with a few hundred horsemen. He died two years later, and Cao spent the next years taking his sons' lands.
story_zh: 汉朝陷入军阀混战后，袁绍占据黄河以北四州，兵力居天下之首。曹操控制黄河以南，手握汉献帝。200年，袁绍挥军南下，双方在官渡相持数月。
曹军人少粮缺，处境艰难。这时袁绍的谋士许攸因不受重用投奔曹操，透露袁军粮草囤积在乌巢。曹操亲率轻兵夜袭，焚毁粮草。袁军顿时大乱，大将投降，袁绍只带八百骑逃回河北，两年后病死。曹操此后几年逐步吞并了袁氏诸子的地盘。
guandu.why: It is a classic case of a smaller army beating a larger one, and it made Cao Cao the master of the north.
guandu.why_zh: 这是以少胜多的经典战例，使曹操成为北方的霸主。

story: In 208 Cao Cao marched south to finish off his rivals. Liu Biao, governor of Jing Province, died, and his son surrendered. Liu Bei fled and sent Zhuge Liang to ask Sun Quan for help. Sun's commanders Zhou Yu and Lu Su argued for resistance, and Sun agreed.

The allies met Cao's fleet at Red Cliffs on the Yangtze. Cao's northern troops were sick and unused to fighting on water. The Wu officer Huang Gai pretended to surrender, then sailed fire ships into Cao's chained fleet. The ships and the camps on shore burned, and Cao retreated north with heavy losses. Liu Bei then took much of Jing Province, while Sun Quan held the lower Yangtze.
story_zh: 208年，曹操挥师南下，想一举消灭对手。荆州牧刘表病死，其子刘琮投降。刘备一路败逃，派诸葛亮到江东求援。孙权手下的周瑜、鲁肃力主抗曹，孙权决定联合刘备。
孙刘联军在长江赤壁与曹军相遇。曹军多是北方人，水土不服，疫病流行，又不习水战。东吴老将黄盖诈降，驾着装满柴草的火船冲入连在一起的曹军战船。战船和岸上营寨一起起火，曹操损失惨重，退回北方。此后刘备夺取荆州大部，孙权稳守长江下游。
red-cliffs.why: It stopped Cao Cao from uniting China and fixed the three-way split that became the Three Kingdoms.
red-cliffs.why_zh: 这一战阻止了曹操统一天下，奠定了三国鼎立的局面。

story: Jiaozhi, in today's northern Vietnam, had been a Han commandery since 111 BCE. In 40 the local noblewomen Trưng Trắc and her sister Trưng Nhị rose against the harsh Han governor Su Ding. According to Vietnamese tradition, Trưng Trắc's husband had been executed. Dozens of settlements joined them, and they ruled from Mê Linh for about three years.

Emperor Guangwu sent the veteran general Ma Yuan with a large army. He defeated the sisters in 43; Chinese records say they were captured and beheaded, while Vietnamese legend says they drowned themselves in a river. Ma Yuan then reorganized local government, built canals and set up bronze columns to mark the frontier.
story_zh: 交趾（今越南北部）自公元前111年起就是汉朝的郡。40年，当地贵族女子征侧和妹妹征贰起兵反抗苛酷的太守苏定。越南传统说法认为，征侧的丈夫被汉官所杀。各地数十个城邑响应，姐妹二人在麊泠自立，统治约三年。
光武帝派老将马援率大军南征，43年平定叛乱。中国史书说姐妹被俘斩首，越南传说则说她们投江自尽。马援随后整顿地方行政，修渠治水，并立铜柱标定边界。
trung-sisters.why: It tightened Han rule over the far south, and in Vietnam the sisters are national heroines of resistance to China.
trung-sisters.why_zh: 此役加强了汉朝对岭南以南地区的控制；在越南，征氏姐妹被尊为反抗中国统治的民族英雄。

story: The Book of the Later Han records that in 57 an envoy from the Wa, as the Chinese called the people of Japan, came to Luoyang with tribute. Emperor Guangwu, in the last year of his reign, gave the ruler of Na a seal and ribbon, a standard way of recognizing foreign chiefs as Han vassals.

In 1784 a farmer on Shika Island near Fukuoka dug up a small gold seal with a snake-shaped knob. Its five characters read "King of Na of Wa of Han." Most scholars accept it as the seal mentioned in the history, though a few have questioned it. It is now a National Treasure of Japan, held at the Fukuoka City Museum.
story_zh: 《后汉书》记载，57年倭人派使者到洛阳朝贡。在位最后一年的光武帝赐给倭奴国王印绶，这是汉朝承认外族首领为藩属的常见做法。
1784年，日本福冈附近志贺岛的一位农民挖出一枚蛇纽小金印，印文是“汉委奴国王”五字。多数学者认为它就是史书所说的那枚印，也有少数人提出怀疑。如今它是日本国宝，收藏在福冈市博物馆。
na-gold-seal.why: It is one of the earliest written links between China and Japan, confirmed by a real object.
na-gold-seal.why_zh: 这是中日交往最早的文字记录之一，并有实物为证。

story: By the first century the Confucian classics existed in rival versions, and different schools read them in different ways. These disagreements mattered, because the classics were the basis of law, ritual and state examinations for office.

In 79 Emperor Zhang called leading scholars to the White Tiger Hall in the palace at Luoyang. For about a month they debated questions about the meaning of the texts, and the emperor himself gave the final rulings. The historian Ban Gu edited the conclusions into a book, the Comprehensive Discussions in the White Tiger Hall. It mixes Confucian ethics with the cosmology of yin, yang and the five phases, and explains the proper bonds between ruler and subject, father and son, and husband and wife.
story_zh: 到了一世纪，儒家经典流传着不同版本，各派学者解释也各不相同。这些分歧并非小事，因为经学是礼法和选官的依据。
79年，汉章帝召集各地名儒到洛阳宫中的白虎观，连续讨论经义一个多月，由皇帝亲自裁决。史学家班固把会议结论整理成《白虎通义》。书中把儒家伦理与阴阳五行学说结合起来，系统阐述了君臣、父子、夫妇等纲常关系。
white-tiger-hall.why: It produced an official version of Han Confucian doctrine, including the Three Bonds that shaped Chinese ethics for centuries.
white-tiger-hall.why_zh: 它确立了汉代官方经学，其中的“三纲”观念影响中国伦理达两千年。

story: In the first century the Xiongnu had split into a southern branch that submitted to Han and a northern branch that stayed hostile. In 88 Dou Xian, brother of the powerful Empress Dowager Dou, was in disgrace for murdering a rival, and asked to lead a campaign to redeem himself.

In 89 his army, with Southern Xiongnu allies, crushed the Northern Xiongnu at Mount Jiluo and pushed deep into the steppe. The historian Ban Gu, who went with the army, composed an inscription carved on Mount Yanran to record the victory. In 2017 researchers confirmed that a cliff inscription in central Mongolia is this text. A further campaign in 91 drove the northern chanyu west, and the Northern Xiongnu ceased to be a threat.
story_zh: 一世纪时，匈奴分裂为南北两部：南匈奴归附汉朝，北匈奴仍与汉为敌。88年，窦太后之兄窦宪因派人刺杀政敌获罪，请求出征匈奴以赎罪。
89年，窦宪率汉军和南匈奴骑兵在稽落山大破北匈奴，一路深入漠北。随军的班固撰写铭文，刻石于燕然山，记录这场胜利。2017年，中蒙学者确认蒙古国中部的一处摩崖石刻正是这篇《封燕然山铭》。91年汉军再次出击，北匈奴单于西逃，从此不再构成威胁。
dou-xian-xiongnu.why: It ended the Northern Xiongnu as a power on China's frontier, and "carving stone at Yanran" became a byword for military glory.
dou-xian-xiongnu.why_zh: 此役使北匈奴退出中国边疆，“燕然勒石”也成为建功立业的代名词。

story: Chinese knew of a great empire far to the west called Daqin, which was the Roman Empire. In 97 Ban Chao, then Protector-General in the Tarim Basin, sent his officer Gan Ying to make contact.

Gan Ying crossed the Parthian Empire and reached Tiaozhi, on the shores of a great sea, probably the Persian Gulf. Parthian sailors told him the crossing could take months or even two years, and that many travelers died of homesickness on the way. Historians suspect the Parthians wanted to protect their position as middlemen in the silk trade. Gan Ying turned back. He brought home reports of the lands he had passed through, which went into the Book of the Later Han.
story_zh: 当时的中国人知道西方有个强大的国家叫大秦，也就是罗马帝国。97年，西域都护班超派部下甘英出使大秦。
甘英穿过安息帝国，抵达条支一带的海边，大概是波斯湾。安息船夫告诉他，渡海顺风也要三个月，遇到逆风可能要两年，很多人在海上思乡而死。史学家推测，安息人是想保住自己在丝绸贸易中的中间商地位。甘英于是折返，带回了沿途各国的见闻，后来被写进《后汉书》。
gan-ying.why: It was the farthest west any known Han envoy traveled, and it added much to Chinese knowledge of western Asia.
gan-ying.why_zh: 这是已知汉朝使者西行最远的一次，大大丰富了中国人对西亚的认识。

story: Xu Shen was a scholar of the classics in Luoyang. Han writing had changed a great deal since the seal script of the Qin, and scholars argued over what old characters meant. Xu Shen set out to explain each character from its oldest form.

He finished the Shuowen Jiezi, "Explaining Simple and Analyzing Compound Characters," around 100, and his son presented it to the throne in 121. It covers 9,353 characters, each given in small seal script with its meaning and an analysis of how it was formed. Xu sorted them under 540 shared components, the first use of the radical system that most Chinese dictionaries still follow. He also described six principles of character formation.
story_zh: 许慎是洛阳的经学家。汉代文字与秦代篆书相比已大有变化，学者对古字含义争论不休。许慎决心从字的最古形体出发，逐一解释。
他约在100年写成《说文解字》，121年由儿子献给朝廷。书中收录9353个字，每字先列小篆，再说明字义并分析字形构造。许慎把这些字按共同的偏旁归入540部，首创部首编排法，此后大多数汉语字典都沿用这一体例。他还系统阐述了造字的“六书”。
shuowen.why: It is the foundation of Chinese philology and still a key tool for reading ancient texts.
shuowen.why_zh: 它是中国文字学的奠基之作，至今仍是阅读古文献的重要工具。

story: Liang Ji was the brother of an empress and the real ruler of the court for almost twenty years. He was famous for his greed and cruelty. In 146 he poisoned the young Emperor Zhi, who had called him an "overbearing general" in public, and put Emperor Huan on the throne.

Emperor Huan grew to hate him. In 159, in a toilet chamber where no one could overhear, he plotted with five eunuchs, sealing the pact by biting one eunuch's arm until it bled. Palace guards surrounded Liang's mansion, and Liang and his wife killed themselves. Dozens of officials linked to him were removed. His confiscated wealth was said to equal half a year of the empire's taxes.
story_zh: 梁冀是皇后之兄，把持朝政近二十年，以贪婪残暴著称。146年，年幼的汉质帝当众称他是“跋扈将军”，梁冀便毒死质帝，另立汉桓帝。
桓帝对梁冀积怨已深。159年，他在厕所里与五名宦官密谋，咬破宦官单超的手臂歃血为盟。随后禁军包围梁府，梁冀夫妇自杀，与他有牵连的官员数十人被罢免。据说抄没的梁家财产相当于朝廷半年的赋税。
liang-ji.why: It ended consort-clan rule but handed power to the eunuchs, whose abuses set off the crises that followed.
liang-ji.why_zh: 外戚专权由此结束，但权力落入宦官之手，他们的胡作非为引发了此后一连串危机。

story: After 159 the eunuchs and their relatives filled government posts. Students at the Imperial Academy and upright officials such as Li Ying denounced them, and the two sides became bitter enemies.

In 166 the eunuchs accused Li Ying and some two hundred others of forming a faction to slander the court. They were jailed and then barred from office for life. In 168 the regent Dou Wu and the scholar Chen Fan planned to kill the eunuchs, but the plot leaked and both died. A second, harsher purge followed in 169: over a hundred men, including Li Ying, died in prison, and hundreds more were exiled or banned. The bans were lifted only in 184, when the court feared the scholars would join the Yellow Turbans.
story_zh: 159年以后，宦官及其亲属占据了大量官职。太学生和李膺等正直官员纷纷抨击，双方积怨日深。
166年，宦官诬告李膺等两百余人结党诽谤朝廷，这些人被捕入狱，后被终身禁锢，不得做官。168年，大将军窦武与太傅陈蕃谋诛宦官，事情泄露，两人遇害。169年又发生了更严酷的第二次党锢，李膺等一百多人死于狱中，数百人被流放或禁锢。直到184年，朝廷担心士人倒向黄巾军，才解除党禁。
partisan-prohibitions.why: It drove the best officials out of government and turned the scholar class against the Han court.
partisan-prohibitions.why_zh: 党锢之祸使大批优秀官员被逐出朝廷，士大夫阶层与汉室离心离德。

story: Hand-copied texts of the Confucian classics varied from copy to copy, and some candidates were said to bribe officials to alter the official versions to match their own answers. In 175 the scholar Cai Yong and others asked Emperor Ling to fix a standard text.

The emperor agreed. Over eight years, seven classics were carved on 46 stone tablets, with Cai Yong said to have written much of the text in clerical script. The tablets stood outside the Imperial Academy in Luoyang, and crowds came to read and copy them; one account says the carts jammed the streets. The tablets were damaged in the wars that followed, but fragments survive and are held in museums today.
story_zh: 儒家经典靠手抄流传，各本文字互有出入，甚至有人贿赂官员篡改官方藏本，以迎合自己的答卷。175年，蔡邕等人上书汉灵帝，请求校定经书文字。
灵帝同意了。此后八年间，七部经书被刻在46块石碑上，据说大部分隶书出自蔡邕之手。石碑立在洛阳太学门外，前来观看和抄写的人络绎不绝，史载车马堵塞街巷。石经在后来的战乱中受损，但仍有残石传世，今藏于各地博物馆。
xiping-classics.why: It was the first official stone edition of the classics in China and a model for later stone-carved texts.
xiping-classics.why_zh: 这是中国第一部官定石刻经书，为后世历代刻经树立了先例。

story: When Emperor Ling died in 189, the regent He Jin planned to wipe out the eunuchs and called frontier generals to Luoyang for support. The eunuchs struck first and killed He Jin. His followers, led by Yuan Shao, then stormed the palace and slaughtered the eunuchs.

In the chaos Dong Zhuo, a general from the northwest frontier, arrived with his troops and took control of the young emperor. He deposed him and enthroned the boy's half-brother as Emperor Xian. Dong made himself chancellor, and his soldiers looted the city. Many officials, including Yuan Shao and Cao Cao, fled east to raise armies against him. Dong's coup ended four hundred years of orderly Han rule in the capital.
story_zh: 189年汉灵帝去世，大将军何进打算铲除宦官，召集边将带兵进京助威。宦官抢先动手，杀了何进。袁绍等人随即率兵攻入皇宫，屠尽宦官。
在一片混乱中，凉州军阀董卓率军赶到，控制了年幼的皇帝。他废黜少帝，改立其异母弟为汉献帝，自任相国，纵兵在洛阳烧杀抢掠。袁绍、曹操等人纷纷逃往关东，起兵讨伐董卓。洛阳的朝廷秩序就此彻底崩溃。
dong-zhuo.why: From this point the Han emperor was a puppet, and the empire broke up into warring regional armies.
dong-zhuo.why_zh: 从此汉朝皇帝沦为傀儡，天下分裂为各自为战的军阀集团。

story: After Dong Zhuo's death, Emperor Xian was passed among warlords in Chang'an. In 195 he escaped east with a few officials, and they reached the ruins of Luoyang, where courtiers had to gather wild plants to eat.

Cao Cao's adviser Xun Yu urged him to take in the emperor. In 196 Cao went to Luoyang and moved the court to Xu, inside his own territory. The emperor kept his title and rituals, but real power lay with Cao. Rivals such as Yuan Shao, who had passed up the same chance, now had to deal with orders issued in the emperor's name. Cao kept the emperor for the rest of his life.
story_zh: 董卓死后，汉献帝在长安被各路军阀争来夺去。195年，他带着少数官员逃向东方，回到残破的洛阳，百官甚至要靠采野菜充饥。
曹操的谋士荀彧劝他迎接天子。196年，曹操赶到洛阳，把朝廷迁到自己控制的许县。献帝保留了皇帝的名号和礼仪，实权却在曹操手中。袁绍等错过机会的对手，如今不得不面对以天子名义发出的命令。这就是后人所说的“挟天子以令诸侯”。
xian-to-xu.why: Holding the emperor gave Cao Cao legal cover for his wars and set up his family's later takeover of the throne.
xian-to-xu.why_zh: 掌控天子让曹操的征战师出有名，也为曹家日后代汉埋下伏笔。

story: Zhang Zhongjing was a physician from Nanyang. According to his own preface, more than two thirds of his large clan died within ten years, most of them from "cold damage," a term for feverish epidemics. This drove him to study old medical texts and gather his own case experience.

Around the start of the third century he wrote the Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases. It describes how fevers move through six stages and matches each pattern of symptoms with a herbal formula. The original was scattered in the wars, but later doctors reassembled it into two books, the Shanghan Lun and the Jingui Yaolue. Many of its formulas are still prescribed.
story_zh: 张仲景是南阳的医生。他在自序中说，宗族二百余人，不到十年就死了三分之二，其中大多死于“伤寒”，即流行的热病。这促使他钻研古代医书，并总结自己的诊疗经验。
大约在三世纪初，他写成《伤寒杂病论》。书中提出热病按六经传变的规律，并针对不同症候给出相应方剂。原书在战乱中散佚，后人整理为《伤寒论》和《金匮要略》两部。书中许多方剂至今仍在使用。
shanghan-lun.why: It set the method of diagnosis by symptom pattern that is still central to traditional Chinese medicine; Zhang is honored as the "Sage of Medicine."
shanghan-lun.why_zh: 它确立了中医辨证施治的方法，张仲景因此被尊为“医圣”。

story: Early in 190, governors and commanders east of Hangu Pass formed an alliance against Dong Zhuo and chose Yuan Shao as its leader. Their armies gathered around Luoyang, but most were unwilling to risk their own troops. Cao Cao attacked alone and was beaten.

Dong Zhuo decided the city was too exposed. He forced Emperor Xian and hundreds of thousands of residents to move west to Chang'an, then burned Luoyang's palaces, temples and houses. His troops also looted the Han imperial tombs. Sun Jian later entered the empty ruins. The coalition soon fell apart, and its members began fighting one another for territory. Luoyang stayed a ruin for years afterward.
story_zh: 190年初，函谷关以东的州郡长官联合起兵讨伐董卓，推举袁绍为盟主。联军屯驻洛阳周边，大多数人却不愿拿自己的兵马冒险，只有曹操孤军出击，结果战败。
董卓觉得洛阳难守，强迫汉献帝和数十万百姓西迁长安，并放火焚烧洛阳的宫殿、宗庙和民宅，还纵兵盗掘汉室陵墓。孙坚后来攻入的只是一片废墟，此后多年洛阳都没能恢复。联军不久便瓦解，各路诸侯转而互相争夺地盘。
anti-dong-coalition.why: The burning of Luoyang destroyed the Han capital, and the collapse of the alliance began the open warlord era.
anti-dong-coalition.why_zh: 洛阳被焚毁，东汉都城化为废墟；联军瓦解后，群雄割据正式开始。

story: In Chang'an Dong Zhuo ruled by terror. He built a fortress at Mei stocked with thirty years of grain and minted debased coins that drove up prices. The minister Wang Yun secretly plotted against him.

Wang won over Lü Bu, Dong's adopted son and bodyguard, who had once been attacked by Dong in a rage and was also having an affair with one of his maids. In 192, as Dong entered the palace, Lü Bu stabbed him to death. The city celebrated. But Wang Yun refused to pardon Dong's officers, so Li Jue and Guo Si marched on Chang'an, killed Wang and drove Lü Bu out. The capital fell into even worse chaos.
story_zh: 在长安，董卓以恐怖手段统治。他在郿县修筑城堡，囤积了够吃三十年的粮食，又铸造劣质小钱，导致物价飞涨。司徒王允暗中谋划除掉他。
王允拉拢了董卓的义子兼贴身护卫吕布。吕布曾被董卓盛怒之下用戟掷击，又与董卓的侍婢私通，心中不安。192年，董卓入宫时被吕布刺杀，长安百姓欢欣鼓舞。但王允拒绝赦免董卓部将，李傕、郭汜便起兵攻入长安，杀死王允，赶走吕布，朝廷陷入更大的混乱。
dong-zhuo-killed.why: Dong's death removed a tyrant but left the court at the mercy of his even less controlled officers.
dong-zhuo-killed.why_zh: 董卓虽死，朝廷却落入更加失控的部将手中。

story: Years of war had emptied the farmland of central China, and armies often starved. Many warlords' troops fed themselves by plunder, and some were reduced to eating mulberries or shellfish.

In 196, on the advice of Zao Zhi and Han Hao, Cao Cao set up farm colonies around Xu. Refugees were given land, oxen and seed, and paid a large share of the harvest to the state. The first year produced a million hu of grain. Cao extended the system across his territories, and soldiers on the frontiers farmed when not fighting. The steady grain supply let him keep large armies in the field and helped him outlast rivals who still depended on looting.
story_zh: 连年战乱使中原大片田地荒芜，军队常常断粮。许多军阀的士兵只能靠抢掠为生，有的甚至以桑葚、河蚌充饥。
196年，曹操采纳枣祗、韩浩的建议，在许县周边推行屯田，招募流民耕种，官府提供土地、耕牛和种子，收成按比例上缴。第一年就收获粮食百万斛。此后曹操把屯田推广到各地，边境士兵也边守边耕。稳定的粮食来源让他能够长期维持大军，在与对手的较量中占据上风。
cao-tuntian.why: It gave Cao Cao the economic base to unite the north, and military farming became a standard tool of later dynasties.
cao-tuntian.why_zh: 屯田为曹操统一北方打下了经济基础，也成为后世王朝常用的办法。

story: In 207 Liu Bei was a guest of Liu Biao in Jing Province, with a famous name but no land of his own. The scholar Xu Shu told him about Zhuge Liang, a young man living in retirement at Longzhong, near Xiangyang, who compared himself to great statesmen of the past.

Liu Bei went to see him three times before they finally met. Zhuge then laid out a strategy: Cao Cao was too strong to fight head on, and Sun Quan should be an ally. Liu Bei should take Jing and Yi provinces, make peace with the peoples of the west and south, and wait for a chance to strike north from both. Liu Bei made him his chief adviser.
story_zh: 207年，刘备寄居荆州刘表门下，虽有声名，却无立足之地。徐庶向他推荐了隐居在襄阳隆中的诸葛亮，说此人常自比管仲、乐毅。
刘备三次前往拜访，才得以相见。诸葛亮为他分析天下形势：曹操势大，不可与之争锋；孙权可以结为外援；刘备应当夺取荆州和益州，安抚西南各族，等待时机从两路北伐。刘备听后大为赞赏，从此重用诸葛亮。
longzhong-plan.why: The plan became the blueprint for the state of Shu Han, and "three visits to the thatched cottage" became a byword for seeking talent.
longzhong-plan.why_zh: 隆中对成为蜀汉立国的蓝图，“三顾茅庐”也成为礼贤下士的代名词。

story: Hefei guarded Cao Cao's southeastern frontier against Wu. In 215, while Cao was campaigning far away in Hanzhong, Sun Quan attacked with about 100,000 men. Hefei was held by Zhang Liao, Yue Jin and Li Dian with only about 7,000 troops.

Following Cao Cao's sealed orders, Zhang Liao chose 800 picked men and charged Sun's camp at dawn, cutting his way to Sun's banner before pulling back into the city. Wu morale collapsed. After about ten days Sun Quan withdrew, and Zhang Liao attacked his rearguard at Xiaoyao Ford. Sun escaped only when his horse jumped across a broken bridge. People in Wu were said to use Zhang Liao's name to frighten crying children.
story_zh: 合肥是曹魏东南防御东吴的要塞。215年，曹操远征汉中，孙权趁机率十万大军攻打合肥。城中由张辽、乐进、李典镇守，只有七千余人。
张辽按照曹操事先留下的密令，挑选八百精兵在拂晓突袭吴营，一直杀到孙权的麾下，然后退回城中。吴军士气大挫，围城十余日后撤退。张辽在逍遥津追击孙权的后军，孙权靠坐骑跃过断桥才得以逃脱。据说此后江东小儿夜啼，大人一说“张辽来了”就不敢再哭。
xiaoyao-ford.why: It made Zhang Liao a legend and showed that Wu could not easily break through Wei's Huai River defenses.
xiaoyao-ford.why_zh: 此战让张辽威名远扬，也表明东吴难以突破曹魏的江淮防线。

story: In 219 Liu Bei took Hanzhong from Cao Cao. His general Guan Yu, who held Jing Province, then marched north and besieged Cao Ren at Fancheng. Autumn rains flooded the Han River, and Guan Yu captured the relief army of Yu Jin, who surrendered. Cao Cao even considered moving the capital away from Xu.

But Sun Quan wanted Jing Province for himself. While Guan Yu was away, the Wu general Lü Meng hid soldiers in merchant boats and took Guan's bases at Jiangling and Gong'an without a fight. Guan Yu's army melted away. He retreated to Maicheng and was captured and executed in early 220. Later he was worshipped across China as a god of loyalty and war.
story_zh: 219年，刘备从曹操手中夺取汉中。镇守荆州的关羽随即北上，围攻曹仁据守的樊城。秋雨连绵，汉水暴涨，关羽俘获了前来救援的于禁所部七军，于禁投降。曹操一度考虑迁都避其锋芒。
然而孙权一直想得到荆州。东吴大将吕蒙趁关羽后方空虚，让士兵扮成商人藏在船中，白衣渡江，不战而取江陵、公安。关羽军心瓦解，退守麦城，220年初被俘遇害。后来他被历代尊奉，成为忠义与武勇之神“关帝”。
fancheng.why: Shu lost Jing Province for good, which wrecked the Longzhong Plan and led Liu Bei into the disaster at Yiling.
fancheng.why_zh: 蜀汉从此永远失去荆州，隆中对的战略落空，刘备也因此发动了惨败的夷陵之战。
